activity_summary: You had played the old man in Errors, and the yard heard every word. You called that worse. John is not asking for a shorter telling. Margery says today was not Tuesday's quiet, and she did not name a new sum. She left Tuesday's nine where she had said it. Garnish is in the middle of the king and will not report a page. The seven shillings stay set by. You are going home by the road. You have seen no paper nailed up.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the yard heard every word, and refused a new sum.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Accepted the length, and kept the fee unspent and unseen.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Separated today's still house from Tuesday's thin one, and gave no new box.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Refused a progress report, and kept the six days.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: They stayed. Twice in three days, a yard that hears every word, which is worse

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: Still is not the same as thin, and I am not naming a new box

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: I am in the middle, and the middle is not a report
